lines.zh: 公鸡昂着头在院子里走
lines.en: The rooster stalks the yard, head high.
Each step looks like an inspection.
Its tail feathers arch high.
Its red comb bobs with every step.
It walks to the front of the hens.
Its claws scratch up the soil.
It cocks its head, one eye down.
It circles the fence line.
It quickens and takes the lead.
Its feet click on the ground.
It slips through the coop door.

lines.zh: 它停在院子中央，四下看
lines.en: It stops mid-yard and looks around.

lines.zh: 脖子一伸一缩，很有派头
lines.en: Its neck pumps, full of swagger.
It steps over the trough without soiling it.

lines.zh: 它朝着篱笆外的方向走
lines.en: It heads for the far side of the fence.

lines.zh: 走两步，它就抬头叫一次
lines.en: Every two steps it lifts its head to crow.

lines.zh: 公鸡站在木桩上，很神气
lines.en: The rooster stands on a post, proud.

lines.zh: 它抖了抖翅膀，羽毛归位
lines.en: It shakes its wings into place.
It pecks at its breast feathers.

lines.zh: 它把脖子伸长，四下张望
lines.en: It stretches its neck to look about.

lines.zh: 它抬起一只脚，慢慢放下
lines.en: It lifts a foot and lowers it slowly.

lines.zh: 它的冠在日光里红得发亮
lines.en: Its comb glows red in the sun.

lines.zh: 它把头一侧，听土里的动静
lines.en: It tilts its head at sounds in the soil.

lines.zh: 它打了个喷嚏似的声音
lines.en: It makes a sound like a sneeze.
A low run of notes rolls in its throat.
It fans its tail a little wider.
It hops off the post and lands clean.
A claw combs through its head feathers.
It stands as if waiting for dawn.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛很亮，一点不困
lines.en: Its eyes are bright, not sleepy at all.
It turns its body to the sun.
Its chest swells, ready to crow.
The rooster turns to face you.
It tilts its head, one eye on you.
It throws its chest out.

lines.zh: 它往前走了半步，不示弱
lines.en: It steps in half a pace, unyielding.
Its comb stands straight.
It sizes you up and down.
It crows once.

lines.zh: 然后它转开脸，不再看你
lines.en: Then it turns away, done with you.
Your shoes interest it.
It pecks the dirt by your feet.
It backs half a step, head still high.
It behaves like the yard's owner.
The rooster shrieks and springs away.
A few feathers fall to the ground.
Its comb sits slightly crooked.
It backs two steps, head still high.
It shakes and steadies.
It crows, and the note wavers.
One wing drops halfway.
It goes around you, heading for the coop.
It walks off, looking back.
But it does not truly flee.

lines.zh: 公鸡朝你手上的东西来了
lines.en: The rooster comes for what you hold.

lines.zh: 它啄了一口，抬头看看你
lines.en: It pecks once and looks up at you.
It shakes the food before swallowing.
Having eaten, it crows.

lines.zh: 我盯着你掌心的浆果，脚下打转。
lines.en: I pace at your feet, eyes fixed on the berry.

lines.zh: 它把碎屑啄得一干二净
lines.en: It takes every crumb.

lines.zh: 它叼着一块跑去给母鸡
lines.en: It carries a piece off to the hens.
It comes back for more.
It pecks too fast and drops some.

lines.zh: 它低头找掉下的那一块
lines.en: It hunts for the dropped piece.
It is quite easy about your hand.
Fed, it shakes itself out.
Its feathers look brighter after.
It rubs against your boot.
It crows again, louder.
It stays by you and will not go.
The rooster hops at the bump.

lines.zh: 我的红冠随步子晃，尾巴翘着。
lines.en: My red comb sways with each step, tail up.
It throws its chest out again.
Its wings beat twice.
It pecks your boot toe.
It gives way, reluctantly.

lines.zh: 它的尾羽扫过你的裤腿
lines.en: Its tail brushes your trouser leg.
It stops and raises its head again.
It crows, as if complaining.
Then goes on about its business.

lines.zh: 公鸡绕着母鸡走了一圈
lines.en: The rooster circles a hen.

lines.zh: 它把翅膀垂下一侧，斜着走
lines.en: It drops one wing and struts sideways.

lines.zh: 它把找到的食物让出去
lines.en: It yields the food it found.

lines.zh: 它低头啄了啄母鸡的颈羽
lines.en: It pecks gently at the hen's neck.
It stands by, watching the surrounds.
They forage together, heads down.

lines.zh: 它把最好的那块叼过去
lines.en: It carries over the best piece.

lines.zh: 它的叫声在院子里回荡
lines.en: Its crow rolls around the yard.

lines.zh: 它们挤在同一处阴凉里
lines.en: They crowd into the same shade.
At dusk they go back to the coop together.
The rooster pecks the food up.
It shakes the dirt off.
It runs off with the item.

lines.zh: 它把食物放下来又啄起
lines.en: It sets it down and picks it up again.

lines.zh: 它对不合口的东西甩头，天亮再说。
lines.en: It shakes its head at what it dislikes; wait till dawn.
It shares the food with the hens.
It picks up a small stone.
It tucks the item under a wing.
Afterward it licks its beak.
It lifts its head, enormously pleased.
The rooster stops dead.
Its comb lifts higher.
Before dawn, I have already crowed.

lines.zh: 我一叫，你就精神到正午。
lines.en: One crow from me and you are alert till noon.
It charges two steps at you.
The feathers on its neck flare.

lines.zh: 天光了，该叫醒整片村子。
lines.en: Daylight, time to wake the whole village.
Its claws scrape the ground twice.

lines.zh: 我侧着身子，一圈圈逼近你。
lines.en: I sidestep in tightening circles around you.
Its tail feathers pull tight.
The rooster circles you.

lines.zh: 它的头一直朝你的方向
lines.en: Its head stays aimed at you.
It probes from behind and to the side.
It leaps and claps its wings.
It gives half a step and comes again.
Its neck feathers stay flared.
Its calls come short and sharp.
It is hunting your ankles.
Its movements quicken.
It keeps itself low.
The rooster leaps and rakes with its spurs.
It pecks your ankle.
Its wings beat your leg.
It strikes your shoe.
One peck and it withdraws.
It springs as high as your knee.

lines.zh: 它的爪子刮过你的裤脚
lines.en: Its claws rake your trouser leg.
It shakes its head, gripping cloth.
It lands again, feathers flared.
Half a step back, then in again.
A long crow rings across the yard.
The rooster walks out of the coop.
It shakes out every feather.
The red comb is sharp in the light.
It hops onto a post and stands tall.

lines.zh: 它伸长脖子又叫了一声
lines.en: It stretches its neck and crows again.

lines.zh: 母鸡们在它身后聚过来
lines.en: The hens gather behind it.

lines.zh: 它把尾羽抖开，像一面旗
lines.en: It fans its tail like a banner.
It drops down and lands clean.
It walks toward you.
Singed feathers send it bouncing about.

lines.zh: 我从草垛上摔下来，翻了个身。
lines.en: I tumble off the haystack and roll over.

lines.zh: 翅膀湿透，它拍得很吃力
lines.en: Soaked wings beat with difficulty.
The blast throws it several blocks.

lines.zh: 天亮前叫一声，你就醒了。
lines.en: One crow before dawn wakes you.
Odd force makes it shudder.
Starving and swaying, it still scratches for food.

lines.zh: 雷把我劈得满身羽毛倒竖。
lines.en: The lightning leaves every feather of mine standing upright.

lines.zh: 虚空一拉，它扑翅往下掉
lines.en: The void pulls; it flaps and drops.
